recognize_zh: 體腔積液抹片中為大型、形態像免疫母細胞/漿母細胞的腫瘤細胞，核大、核仁明顯、細胞質豐富且嗜鹼性；免疫染色 HHV-8（LANA-1）呈核內強陽性，插圖 EBER 原位雜交為陰性，符合 HHV-8 陽性、EBV 陰性的原發性積液淋巴瘤。
features: Large discohesive neoplastic cells with round to irregular nuclei and prominent nucleoli (immunoblastic/plasmablastic appearance)
Moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm, some with perinuclear hof
Occasional multinucleated or bizarre cells; apoptotic bodies and neutrophils in the background
IHC for HHV-8 LANA-1 shows diffuse speckled nuclear positivity in nearly all tumor cells
EBER in situ hybridization (inset) negative in tumor cell nuclei
describe_en: Effusion cytology shows a cellular specimen composed of large discohesive neoplastic cells with round to irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm, with scattered apoptotic debris. Immunohistochemistry for HHV-8 latency-associated nuclear antigen (LANA-1) shows diffuse nuclear positivity in the tumor cells. EBER in situ hybridization is negative. Findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma, HHV-8-positive and EBV-negative, an uncommon variant typically seen in elderly HIV-negative patients from HHV-8-endemic regions.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with secondary effusion
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells usually express CD20/CD79a and are HHV-8 negative, whereas PEL is CD20-negative with HHV-8 LANA-1 nuclear positivity.

ddx.dx: Fluid overload-associated large B-cell lymphoma (HHV-8-negative effusion-based lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar but, by definition, HHV-8 LANA-1 negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or mesothelioma in effusion
ddx.vs: Epithelial and mesothelial cells form cohesive clusters and are keratin/calretinin positive and negative for HHV-8 and CD45/CD138.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: These are HHV-8 negative (plasmablastic lymphoma often EBER positive) and usually present as a mass or marrow disease rather than a body-cavity effusion.

stain: Giemsa-type; IHC: HHV-8 LANA-1; ISH: EBER
